# CloudCert Lab — Multi-Cloud & AI Certification Exam Simulator (2026–2027)

> Zero-login interactive exam simulator covering 8 official AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud certifications (120 free scenario questions + 2,080 Pro Vault scenarios across 32 timed mock exams for $19.99 one-time).

- Live Simulator: https://gabhack.github.io/cloudcert-lab/
- Pro All-Access Vault ($19.99 one-time, 2,080 questions + offline ZIP): https://gabbler407.gumroad.com/l/cloudcert-lab-pro
- Companion Amazon Kindle / Paperback Series (Free on Kindle Unlimited): https://www.amazon.com/author/gabrieln
